description: Deployment units and their order. scripts/deploy-unit.ps1 refuses anything not listed here or listed with enabled false. A unit marked "route": "hand" is never deployed by the pipeline, a person runs it by hand. Paths are relative to the repository root.

allowedPrincipals.use: Interactive, reviewed runs by hand. Fill in your own sign-in name to run deploy-unit.ps1 yourself. An empty name never matches.

The client ID of the reader identity id-mirror-reader. Pull request previews, the plan of every deployment and drift checks sign in with it (environments mirror-reader and mirror-reader-dispatch). Fill in when the identity exists. An empty name never matches.
The client ID of the deploy identity for the demo subscription (environment mirror-production-demo). Fill in only for a subscription deployed from the pipeline. An empty name never matches.

units.name: pilot-empty-rg
units.notes: Empty template against rg-demo-pilot, an empty resource group created by hand for the pilot alone. Proves identity, roles, the reviewers' approval and evidence capture without touching a resource.

units.name: rg-demo-network
units.notes: One network security group with no rules of its own and one virtual network with one subnet, which that network security group protects. Free resources only.

units.name: rg-demo-routing
units.notes: One route table with no routes and one application security group. Free resources only.

units.name: demo-subscription
units.notes: Demo subscription layer: the three resource groups rg-demo-pilot, rg-demo-network and rg-demo-routing, written out as they are live. The resources inside the groups deploy from their own resource group files in resource-groups/, one unit each, and main.bicep does not call those files. Deployed by hand, never by the pipeline ("route": "hand"). A subscription main.bicep is where a subscription's role assignments and policy belong, which no pipeline deploy identity can write, so none can raise its own rights. A person deploys it with deploy-unit.ps1 from a PowerShell window. A code pull request still previews it for information.
